assumptions: The byte-freeze manifest remains authoritative for product identity, local cache keys, byte lengths and SHA-256 values.
FITS binary-table scalar layout is big-endian as declared by the standard and the selected TTE headers.
TIME is converted only with the per-table TSCAL/TZERO metadata; no detector-to-geocenter or leap-second conversion is inferred.
The one-second trigger-relative histogram rule is frozen before any candidate comparison and is not fitted to a candidate.
Reading raw TTE rows is an additive source-feature operation and does not authorize response, likelihood or physical-map admission.
boundary: R-473 is a T0 claim-nonbearing finite raw-event feature index. It advances only the detector-frame feature portion of F_reg for two already hash-pinned TTE products. The physical owner, calibration, time-standard, geocenter, likelihood, covariance, nuisance, F_lim/F_eff/F_obs, prospective, physical-identity, continuum and mass-gap gates remain open.
evidence_level: T0 exact hash-pinned raw-row extraction with independent parser, hostile mutations and Lean arithmetic cross-check
falsifiers: Any source hash or byte-length mismatch.
A malformed EVENTS table, unsupported column format, out-of-bounds row span or non-finite decoded value.
A time outside the header interval, a decreasing event sequence or a PHA outside [0,127].
Histogram conservation, common-edge, digest or primary/independent parity failure.
Any attempt to read response coefficients, infer geocenter timing, admit a likelihood/covariance, or score a candidate from this feature index.
Any method, owner-order, prospective-lock or physical-scope promotion mutation.
missing_assumptions: A source-owned or independently reproduced calibration release and validity/interpolation rule.
A common time-standard and detector-to-geocenter transformation with uncertainty.
A fixed source-owned detector, energy, background and onset-selection rule.
A joint timing likelihood or covariance including calibration, shared-source and selection terms.
A preregistered intrinsic-emission-lag nuisance law or calibrated set-valued scoring rule.
A complete F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs microscopic map, immutable scorer and prospective holdout.

It does not supply a geocenter correction, calibration validity, intrinsic-emission law, microscopic dynamics, physical projection or candidate score.
It does not prove Pre-A, C6, A13, Sector-A, QFT, Yang-Mills, gravity, a continuum limit, cosmic origin, a theory of everything or a mass gap.
It does not replace the Reading-H physical-empty branch or any existing T-054 forward proof step.
The established T-054 forward method, T-059/T-061 inverse method, owner order and promotion firewalls are unchanged.
